authority: sole repository authority for planned work, priorities, dependencies, blockers, and completion criteria

nodes.title: Focused atmospheric reference-value authority
nodes.summary: Shared conventional atmospheric defaults live in small immutable thermodynamic and geophysical authorities; domain kernels own narrow caller-overridable parameter records rather than duplicated literals or a global mutable configuration object.
completion: Thermodynamic and geophysical reference values have focused versioned authorities.
Dry thermodynamics, moist vapor algebra, and pressure hydrostatics source shared defaults from those authorities.
Cross-kernel witnesses prove default coherence and kernel-local override isolation.
Canonical source contains no second hardcoded authority for the shared Rd, cp, Rv, reference-pressure, or standard-gravity values.

nodes.title: Deplete and delete legacy root monoliths
nodes.summary: Mine useful domain semantics from non-authoritative root prototypes into canonical code, contracts, tests, or another planning node, then delete the depleted source. Git history is the archive; the working tree does not keep compatibility monoliths merely for historical reference.
completion: No root-level climate_* scientific prototype remains.
No legacy-only compile lane or module-registry entry remains.
Every still-useful unmet semantic from removed prototypes is represented by a canonical contract, executable witness, or this planning graph.
Repository policy defines auditable mining and deletion criteria for future legacy depletion.

nodes.title: Recompose pressure-coordinate physics around authoritative fluxes
nodes.summary: Compose mass continuity, conservative tracer transport, pressure work, and energy exchange around the same authoritative carrier-mass flux with explicit geometry, area, layer-pressure thickness, gravity, and sign conventions.
completion: One coupling contract binds mass, tracer, continuity-divergence, and energy transport to the same carrier-mass flux.
Pressure-coordinate face-flux to divergence mapping has explicit dimensional and geometric inputs.
Manufactured or exact witnesses demonstrate coupled mass/tracer/energy consistency without inventing a generic horizontal-grid framework.

nodes.title: Establish physical parameterization seams and library boundaries
nodes.summary: Keep climate-owned equations, coupling semantics, and diagnostics local while delegating commodity radiation, remapping, integration, transforms, optimization, and linear algebra to mature libraries.
completion: Radiation, remapping, time integration, and generic linear-algebra boundaries name maintained production libraries and independent reference witnesses.
Boundary-layer, convection, microphysics, and component-exchange interfaces carry explicit units and owned budget terms before implementation expansion.
No generic solver or transform stack is promoted from deleted legacy prototypes.

nodes.title: Define typed physical-state boundaries
nodes.summary: Represent prognostic physical state, derived diagnostics, and experimental representations as distinct contracts with explicit units, coordinates, missingness, and initialization semantics.
completion: Physical fields cannot be silently initialized from synthetic observational defaults.
Experimental geometry or diagnostic artifacts do not inhabit authoritative prognostic state without an explicit adapter.
State-boundary fixtures cover missing, unavailable, and zero as distinct cases where scientifically relevant.

nodes.title: Rebuild spectral and oscillation diagnostics from narrow contracts
nodes.summary: Define scientifically narrow spectra, coherence, wavelet, climate-index, and oscillation diagnostics around maintained transform/statistics libraries rather than omnibus placeholder algorithms.
completion: Each diagnostic names its input sampling, normalization, units, missing-data semantics, and independent benchmark.
FFT and standard transform machinery use maintained libraries in production paths.
Forecast-skill or named climate-index outputs cannot be synthesized by arbitrary fallback formulas.

nodes.title: Create one immutable observational or reanalysis projection
nodes.summary: Build a narrow CF-aware data projection with explicit retrieval identity, QC, missingness, transformation lineage, coordinates, units, and content digests before expanding acquisition breadth.
completion: One real dataset projection is reproducible from immutable source identity through preprocessing to experiment input.
Missing observations are never silently replaced by climatology or defaults in validation paths.
A compact network-free fixture exercises the same schema and transformation semantics in CI.

nodes.title: Define narrow versioned array FFI contracts
nodes.summary: Cross-language adapters expose only implemented backends with explicit dtype, shape, layout, ownership, lifetime, error, and capability-discovery semantics.
completion: FFI schemas make array ownership and memory layout unambiguous.
Unavailable language backends fail capability discovery instead of returning placeholder array descriptors.
Round-trip fixtures cover each advertised backend.

nodes.title: Exercise read-only Commons execution lineage
nodes.summary: Run one sandboxed Climate experiment through Commons while preserving run, trace, causation, build, artifact, and evidence identity without creating a second scheduler in Climate.
blockers: Requires an available integrated Commons execution environment and authorization boundary.
completion: One real read-only or sandboxed execution preserves Climate scientific semantics and end-to-end lineage.
Climate owns only local numerical scheduling and checkpoint semantics; global resource arbitration remains external.

nodes.title: Verify nonlinear coordinate covariance
nodes.summary: Extend independent geometry verification to a nonlinear coordinate transformation including the inhomogeneous Christoffel transformation term.
completion: A nonlinear analytic fixture has independently generated transformed metric and Christoffel quantities.
Canonical geometry agrees within scale-aware tolerances and detects an intentionally omitted inhomogeneous term.

nodes.title: Add a second independent metric-derivative route
nodes.summary: Add an AD or complex-step derivative witness where supported, keeping derivative-estimation acceptance policy outside the mathematical MetricJet contract.
completion: At least two materially independent derivative-generation routes agree on shared analytic fixtures.
Conditioning and derivative-estimation failures remain explicit diagnostics rather than repaired tensors.

nodes.title: Validate information-geometry primitives on explicit statistical models
nodes.summary: Use explicit likelihood families for Fisher, connection, identifiability, natural-gradient, and recovery experiments, with maintained optimization libraries and standard baselines.
completion: Synthetic observations are explicit experiment inputs rather than hidden inside method implementations.
Parameter-recovery and held-out likelihood tasks compare natural-gradient behavior against standard optimizers and equally informed preconditioners.

nodes.title: Realize station-cover sheaf semantics
nodes.summary: Define a climate-data cover, typed stalk contents, restrictions, identity/composition laws, coboundary, and compatibility semantics before interpreting cohomological diagnostics.
completion: Station or coverage rules generate a declared nerve and typed restriction maps.
Restriction identity and composition have executable witnesses.
Injected-fault and withheld-data fixtures compare sheaf quantities against same-information residual, QC, graph, and interpolation baselines.

nodes.title: Ground multirepresentation weighting in real cost and noise authority
nodes.summary: Move beyond equal-cost synthetic observation design only when real acquisition cost, noise, provenance, and missingness authorities exist; do not tune representation weights to downstream scores in their absence.
blockers: Requires a real dataset with defensible observation-cost and noise metadata.
completion: Observation-design objectives use externally grounded cost/noise data rather than arbitrary scalar weights.
Fast/slow modal information, Fisher rank, and acquisition cost remain separate reported objectives unless a decision policy explicitly combines them.

nodes.title: Test climate encodings for exact ultrametric primitives
nodes.summary: Keep exact p-adic mathematics separate from the empirical hypothesis that a climate encoding improves teleconnection tasks, and compare against generic hierarchy, graph, spectral, Euclidean, learned, and randomized controls.
completion: Encoding choices are preregistered without target leakage.
Held-out tasks attribute any gain to the encoding rather than to unequal information access or arbitrary geographic weighting.

nodes.title: Give Clifford representations a falsifiable climate task
nodes.summary: Evaluate canonical Clifford algebra representations on a declared multicomponent or oriented-dynamics task against complex spectra, Hilbert phase, wavelets, bispectra, and DMD/Koopman baselines.
completion: The Clifford representation is mathematically canonical for the declared signature and dimension.
Incremental task value is measured against simpler phase/spectral representations with matched information.

nodes.title: Separate climate feasibility from modal truth
nodes.summary: Construct climate-specific worlds, propositions, and accessibility relations through an explicit adapter while keeping canonical Kripke satisfaction semantics independent of heuristic plausibility scores.
completion: Physical feasibility construction has explicit data/model provenance and no hidden probability interpretation.
Modal truth tests consume only the declared finite frame and valuation produced by the adapter.

nodes.title: Separate approximate climate symmetry diagnostics from exact Noether structure
nodes.summary: Use exact variational-symmetry references as mathematical authority and evaluate approximate climate symmetry indicators as diagnostics with explicit baselines rather than conservation-law claims.
completion: Exact conservation-law language is reserved for witnessed variational symmetries.
Approximate symmetry diagnostics have declared tasks, scales, uncertainty, and conventional comparison methods.

nodes.title: Isolate climate-specific optimization objectives
nodes.summary: Retain only climate-specific objective, constraint, and provenance semantics locally; generic optimization, AD, eigensolvers, and linear algebra come from maintained libraries.
completion: Climate-owned objective/constraint contracts are independently testable without a local generic optimizer stack.
Benchmark and recovery experiments compare maintained optimizers under equivalent information and stopping rules.

nodes.title: Prepare GPU differential execution only for a justified workload
nodes.summary: Accelerate a geometry or representation workload only after profiling establishes a real bottleneck; generic device linear algebra and transforms use vendor libraries and execution identity remains fail closed.
blockers: Requires a scientifically useful workload with a demonstrated CPU/reference bottleneck.
Hardware correctness and performance claims require an actual CUDA device.
completion: CPU/reference fixtures and stage-level tolerances exist before device optimization.
Real-device tests cover execution identity, conditioning, determinism, transfers, VRAM, and differential agreement.
No compatibility shim can satisfy a requested CUDA/NCCL/tensor-core identity.
